ITEM 1 | Orange-coral cylindrical pieces, roughly 2 to 4 cm long and 1 to 1.5 cm thick, smooth matte surface with slight sheen, some pieces with rounded ends and faint lengthwise ridges, a few slightly curved, arranged in a loose cluster covering about one-third of a square white plate, holding their shape with no visible liquid or sauce | 110

ITEM 2 | Small orange-coral piece, about 2 cm long and 1 cm wide, smooth and firm with a slightly glossy surface, lying separately at the lower edge of the pile on the white plate | 8
